work.name: 360Learning
work.summary: Tech Lead driving the engineering strategy and core system integration for the Skills product domain following the acquisition of eLamp.
highlights: 👥 Built, mentored, and led a high-performing squad of 5 experienced senior developers on the Skills domain, establishing engineering best practices and technical roadmap ownership.

🏛️ Architected the complex, deep integration between the legacy eLamp Skills engine and the core 360Learning platform, resolving intricate multi-tenant, data-consistency, and state-synchronization challenges.
🕸️ Overcame major technical hurdles in aligning disparate data models, merging real-time skills taxonomy engines with 360Learning’s architecture.
🔄 Designed integration pipelines to synchronize enterprise client skills data across both platforms with zero downtime.
🤝 Fostered technical collaboration between the Skills team and core platform squads to streamline cross-system dependencies and maintain platform stability.

work.name: eLamp
work.summary: Led a small engineering team (5+ engineers), drove AI R&D and infrastructure teams to build scalable AI-driven skills platforms.
highlights: 👥 Co-founded the platform, grew the R&D and engineering teams from inception, and established the technology vision leading to successful acquisition.
🤖 Designed and implemented proprietary fine-tuned ML transformer models and Knowledge Graph architectures for automated skills mapping and RAG-based intelligence.
☸️ Engineered cloud-native DevOps infrastructure on Kubernetes, establishing robust CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and real-time operational monitoring.
🧠 Bridged AI research with product engineering, translating complex semantic data models into scalable enterprise features.
🔒 Built enterprise-grade security and scalable infrastructure serving tier-1 industrial clients (e.g., Bouygues Construction, Naval Group, Artelia).
